also: I don’t want to be nosey, but …

terms.gloss: given for “I don’t want to be nosey, but …”
terms.comment: Libet is impersonal, so the nominative cūriōsus has nothing to agree with. Nōlō cūriōsus esse, sed … says it soundly: nōlō, like volō, has a subject for the adjective to agree with.

phrases.latin: Puer tamen cūriōsus in lupum apertum iterum īnspexit
phrases.english: But the boy, curious, looked into the opened bass again

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 154, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).
